app.name: SuperTux 2 Wii
app.long_description:
Wii port of the classic platformer starring Tux the Penguin - Based on Milestone 2 of the game, originally released in 2016 - Includes over 150 levels spread across 7 worlds - Supports Wii Remote, Nunchuk, Classic Controller, GameCube controller & USB keyboard
For more info, visit: github.com/DeltaResero/SuperTux2-Wii
